gloss: to suspend; to pause; to halt

definitions.gloss: to suspend; to pause; to halt; to be on hiatus
definitions.explanation: To temporarily stop an activity, service, or operation. Implies the intention or possibility of resuming later.

examples.japanese: ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧{休止|きゅうし}する。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{休止|きゅうし}して⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has been three years since that band went on hiatus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{休止|きゅうし}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Train service has been suspended due to the typhoon.

notes:
Implies a temporary pause with the expectation of resumption, unlike ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧ which often implies cancellation. Very common in transportation announcements, service updates, and entertainment news (band hiatuses).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活動休止|かつどうきゅうし}: hiatus from activities (often for celebrities/bands)
- {運行休止|うんこうきゅうし}: suspension of service (trains, buses)
- {一時休止|いちじきゅうし}: temporary suspension
- {無期限休止|むきげんきゅうし}: indefinite suspension
- {休止中|きゅうしちゅう}: currently suspended/on hiatus

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧: to cancel; to discontinue — implies stopping completely, not just pausing
- ⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}する→中断する：18998_chuudansuru⟧: to interrupt; to break off — stopping something that was in progress, often unexpectedly
- ⟦{停止|ていし}する→停止する：20992_teishisuru⟧: to stop; to halt — a complete stop, often mechanical or legal; more final than ⟦{休止|きゅうし}→休止：17081_kyuushi⟧
